title: Announce Check
user: Small web teams that need to verify the screen-reader announcements of one critical signup, search, or form flow before release.
smallest_useful_product: NPM CLI plus local HTML reporter that drives a short scripted browser flow, captures accessibility-tree/ARIA-live changes, compares them to a checked-in expected transcript, and points to the first divergence.
constraints: Accessibility trees are not equivalent to screen-reader speech. Run against local or explicitly authorized URLs. Keep fixture data local and never log form values.
